title: Chesterville and District Heritage Centre

services.name: Programs & Registration
services.desc: The Department of Recreation and Culture offers a variety of programming - everything from zumba to swim lessons. It also strives to ensure that recreation is available to all members of our community, with programs such as the recreation lending library and the skate and lending library. The department oversees the township’s recreational buildings and other facilities. These arenas, community centres and meeting rooms are home to many community groups and programs. blurb: The Chesterville and District Historical Society was founded in 1984. North Dundas’ agricultural heritage is expressed through its farms and in its historic commercial centres that include Winchester, Chesterville, Morewood, South Mountain, Mountain and Inkerman.
